facts.architecture: Swift 1.5 (Qwen3.8-27B retrained by UkisAI to think less) in a smaller allocation: 64 layers, of which 16 attend fully (the rest are linear-attention layers with a recurrent state); an MTP head

template.source: Qwen's reference chat template, as design 0012 §4.2 reads it: earlier thinking rendered only after the last user message, tool calls as XML; the template inside the model file is still to read (design 0012 §10)

files.notes: IQ3_XXS with ISTA-DASLab's GSQ-RCO allocation, refined by UkisAI, the MTP head embedded: 1,600 MiB less of the GPU than the IQ3_S file, for a KL divergence from the BF16 model of 0.0978 against 0.0513 (UkisAI's development measure; 0.0625 against 0.0354 on held-out code). Under the Swift Open License v1.0. No vision projector

kvmem-llamacpp.source: Its tensors read with gguf's reader on 2026-10-18: 9,560.19 MiB beside the 388.38 MiB token embedding, which llama.cpp keeps on the CPU (the same reading of the IQ3_S file gives the 11,159.69 MiB its start logged); the rest as Swift 1.5's IQ3_S, whose layers and pools are the same; layers: the 66 KVMem's log offloads for Qwen3.8-27B's file, whose layers are the same ("offloaded 66/66 layers to GPU", 2026-10-12), which the estimate splits the weights by when fewer are on the GPU
